sources.title: Central Bank of Bahrain, Official Bank Holidays: Holidays During 2026 (last updated 23 December 2025)
sources.said: 1 January 2026 New Year’s Day; 20, 21, 22 March 2026 Eid Al Fitr * 1447; 1 May 2026 Labour Day; 27, 28, 29 May 2026 Eid Al Adha * 1447; 16 June 2026 Al Hijra New Year* 1448; 24, 25 June 2026 Ashoora * 1448; 25 August 2026 Prophets Birthday * 1448; 16, 17 December 2026 National Day. *All Islamic holidays are subject to confirmation at the time.
